title: The Witch's Hut
text: A hut on chicken legs scratches in the leaves, turning to face you as its door creaks open. The witch inside is all knuckles and teeth. For a year of your life, she offers a cure. Her shelves are lined with jars of years.

options.label: The most wounded trades her a year and takes the cure.

outcomes.text: The wound closes, but they feel older and move like it. A new jar sits on her shelf.

options.label: The shrewdest haggles her down; a year is too dear.

outcomes.text: She settles for a month instead, and the cure is good.
She is insulted, and she is a witch.

options.label: Leave her be; no cure is worth the years on those shelves.

outcomes.text: The hut follows a while before losing interest. Where its claws scratched the path, it has left a bundle of good herbs.
The hut follows a while before losing interest. The witch leans out to spit after you.

options.label: The one in a hood haggles with her, witch to witch.

outcomes.text: She cackles and takes a lock of hair instead of a year. The cure is real.
